The invitation

She’s already there.

Perhaps you’ve felt her in a moment when you stopped thinking about how you looked, what you should be doing, or how anyone else might perceive you.

A moment when you simply got to be.

Unfiltered. Unapologetic. Completely you.

Join Natty Lou and Hayley Bloom in Bali for four deeply immersive days—a space to put down the things you carry, step away from the roles you play, and reconnect with the woman beneath it all.

To explore her. To trust her voice, her intuition, her creativity, her magic.

And to discover what it feels like to live from that place.

Give her a little more room.

This is an invitation for the woman who…

  • Wants space to hear her own voice beneath the expectations of everyday life.
  • Has felt glimpses of herself and longs to explore that feeling more deeply.
  • Is curious about her creativity, her intuition and what wants to be expressed.
  • Wants to feel comfortable being seen, without needing to perform.
  • Is ready to bring more of herself into her relationships, her work and her creations.

Meet Natty

Natty is passionate about guiding women back to themselves through embodiment, presence and self-remembrance.

As an embodiment guide and photographer, she has spent years creating spaces where women feel safe to let go of who they think they need to be and reconnect with the woman they have always been.

Her approach is grounded, intuitive and deeply experiential, weaving together embodiment practices, guided meditation, reflection, conversation and her signature embodiment photography to help women reconnect with their bodies, awaken their inner wisdom and experience themselves in a whole new way.

Natty believes that transformation isn’t about becoming someone else. It’s about remembering who you were before the world told you who you needed to be.

At The Language of Her, Natty will gently guide you to slow down, reconnect with your body, trust yourself again and capture your journey through a deeply personal embodiment photography experience - so you leave not only with beautiful images, but with a lasting reminder of the woman you remembered here.

She can’t wait to welcome you home to yourself.

Meet Hayley

Hayley is passionate about creating spaces where women can slow down, breathe deeply, and remember who they truly are.

After her own journey of healing and choosing herself, she now supports women to reconnect with their hearts, trust their intuition, and embrace the woman they’ve always been beneath the expectations, the roles, and the noise of everyday life.

With a gentle, grounded presence, Hayley weaves together embodiment, energy healing, reflection and heartfelt connection to create experiences that feel safe, nurturing and deeply transformative.

She believes we don’t need fixing. We simply need the space to be seen, supported and reminded of the wisdom that has always lived within us.

At The Language of Her, Hayley will lovingly hold space for you to soften, reconnect with yourself, and leave Bali with a deeper sense of peace, clarity and self-trust.

She can’t wait to welcome you home to yourself.
